[quote=oceanice_republics;60426201][i][b]Official Statement from the Government of the OER[/b]

The Oceanic Enclave Republic officially declares the immediate imposition of sanctions against the Sanguinian Democratic Republic and the Socialist Republic of Qianxun. Effective immediately, all trade routes across the Argos Ocean and Archal Ocean are closed to the regimes.

This has been made for defending peace, stability, and the values of democracy against the expanding threats posed by socialist and communist aggression. In coordination with our allies within the EDU, the Oceanic Enclave Republic is willing to suspend all trade, financial relations, and investment activity with both the Sanguinian Democratic Republic and the Socialist Republic of Qianxun.

Enforce strict naval and aerial blockades to prevent any cargo or commercial activity from reaching or passing through the Argos and Archal Oceans. Coordinate intelligence sharing and enforcement measures with EDU partners to ensure the effectiveness of these sanctions.

[u]Statement from President Ironvisak Willham[/u]

"The Oceanic Enclave Republic will never allow hostile socialist and communist regimes to undermine the liberty and prosperity of free nations. These sanctions and trade blockades are not acts of aggression, they are measures of defense, designed to protect our people, our allies, and the stability of the global order. We stand united with our partners in the EDU, resolute in our belief that peace is preserved through strength and vigilance. The enemies of freedom will find no safe passage through our oceans, no access to our markets, and no influence over our democratic way of life.

Our message is clear. we will defend our sovereignty, we will defend our allies, and we will defend democracy itself."[/u][/i][/quote]

[b]Arenese response to Qianxun and Sanguinian sanctions[/b]

Recently, the president of the Arenese Stated Socialist Republics has caught wind of the news on sanctions. The government has issued a response to both the EDU and Oceanice Republics, asking to stop the sanctions.

[i]    The EDU has imposed sanctions on our brothers. For what reason? They say that it was because Qianxun has overthrown the Sanguinian democracy. But I ask you today, was not the democracy already fractured and ready to die? If it was so easy for Qianxun to influence the government, that must mean that their state was about to implode on itself. Now, think about what would have happened if the state received no influence from Qianxun. Think about what would happen to their economy, their culture, and their people. The economy would crack, go flat. The people would starve. The only way to survive would be from international support and hope that they would not have. 

    So I ask you another question. Do you really not think that the overthrowing of the Sanguinian government was good? Oh, the humanity! You'd rather let the people of Sanguivallis die, than be under a socialist and communist regime? I give you a challenge. Take an axe, and go butcher a human. Feel the weight of one innocent life dying. Now think of the hundreds of thousands, millions even, of lives that might have died if their government was left alone. So I ask you a final question. Would you drop sanctions on a helping country? Would you block food from going to a nation that has inevitably saved lives? That is my argument. Now the Arenese government has no thought of taking action as of right now. But I will send monetary and food supplies to Qianxun with [b]NO[/b] interference. We have the right to do so. [/i]
